description: The system-level invariants (properties of the LIVE system, not of any single PR). Every change spec cites the invariant ids it touches; the liveness gate and CI consume the same ids. Tier: per-PR (fast, free), nightly, release (smoke run).

invariants.name: loop-sampler-exit
invariants.statement: a dispatch's method family is sampled with a logged propensity — 'default' strategy rows are anomalies, never the norm

invariants.name: loop-admission-consumed
invariants.statement: the policy's plan() admission receipt is consumed at dispatch (the envelope carries the admitted set)

invariants.name: loop-posterior-moves
invariants.statement: settlement updates the posterior store under a NON-EMPTY arm key — the reward channel is alive at family level; case-level posterior movement (key-less rows) never satisfies the sentinel (#807 family-level upgrade)

invariants.name: oracle-armed-at-init
invariants.statement: every analysis workspace has armed oracle cases derived from its anchors — no reward source, no analysis

invariants.name: iron-log-append-tolerance
invariants.statement: the upgrade iron rule tolerates live appends to the kunglao event log and still rejects rewrites/deletions (#764)

invariants.name: recall-default-off
invariants.statement: reference-recall injection is opt-in (KUNGLAO_RECALL=1) per the #694 measurement, until the scorer earns its cost back (#771)

invariants.name: upgrade-transactional-flow
invariants.statement: upgrade = snapshot, prune, deploy, configure, selfcheck, reload-prompt-or-rollback — in that order, self-gated (#774)
